summary.headline: Additions and Corrections
summary.text: Addenda and corrigenda to Codices Italici, correcting folio references, readings, attributions, and deletions across the catalog. The page discusses lunar configurations, Maximus, Constantinople, Iulianus, Paulus Alexandrinus, Theophilus, and the seven ages of the world, comparing Byzantine planetary cycles with Bardesanes of Edessa and Georgius, bishop of the Arabs.
